conf.description: F5 BIG-IP LTM HSL request logging (syslog-kv, canonical Telemetry Streaming request/response template), direct route: kvp extract into ECS + f5_bigip.ltm.* customs, SNAT-disabled fallback, virtual_name tenant/application split, ms->ns duration, keep _raw. No usable Elastic integration exists for this feed.

conf.comment: F5 BIG-IP LTM HSL request logging, syslog-kv, direct route. No usable Elastic integration exists (f5_bigip only ingests Telemetry Streaming JSON), so this pipeline is the only parser. event_timestamp is assumed to be the $DATE_HTTP token per the work order's default template; a site standardised on $TIME_UNIX instead would still parse via auto_timestamp's own format detection, but that is unverified against a live sample. snat_ip/snat_port are only promoted to source.nat.* when they differ from the client address, since F5 returns the client IP itself when SNAT is disabled. response_ms->event.duration assumes the ms token; a site using $RESPONSE_USECS instead is not covered (no such field row exists in this inventory).

functions.description: Pipeline purpose, timestamp-token assumption, and the SNAT/duration caveats
Message body: a Cribl Syslog Source leaves the full line, header included, in _raw and the body in message; anything else carries the body in _raw.
Extract the quoted key=value HSL template directly from _raw (delimiter handling unverified against a live sample - see README gap)

Suppress the SNAT-disabled false-positive, split virtual_name into tenant/application, strip the HTTP/ version prefix, split http_uri into path/query, and convert response_ms to nanosecond event.duration - all BEFORE rename, reading the flat vendor field names
Batch rename of every mapped/custom (no-transform) key
Set _time from the request/response profile's own timestamp token
Tag event.dataset (matching this dir's existing request-log__json.json thin pipeline); drop now-consumed parse scratch. _raw is deliberately kept.
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
